query:
SELECT 'schedule' AS "kind!", COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count!" FROM schedule
        UNION ALL SELECT 'http', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM http_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'websocket', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM websocket_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'kafka', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM kafka_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'nats', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM nats_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'postgres', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM postgres_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'mqtt', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM mqtt_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'sqs', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM sqs_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'gcp', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM gcp_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'azure', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM azure_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'amqp', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM amqp_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'email', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM email_trigger
        UNION ALL SELECT 'native', COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM native_trigger
